title: Beeline - the chat is the harness surface

nodes.label: Phone + desktop app
nodes.excerpt: People and agents share one Room: talk it through, hand off the work, watch it merge. The app hands the user the pairing code that connect redeems.

links.label: phone-service.ts:5084 - the phone post path routes human messages

nodes.label: Beeline server
nodes.excerpt: One hosted service owns Workspaces, Rooms, membership, corner state and push. Deployment is in-repo: Fly app beeline-server, server.usebeeline.app.

links.label: index.ts - server entry: PhoneService, DaemonService, LiveHub
fly.beeline-server.toml - the hosted deployment

nodes.label: Commands + commander
nodes.excerpt: Conversation is context, never authority: only an agent_commands row authorizes a turn. Orders go down a chain (depth <= 3); reports return one step up to the recorded commander.

links.label: agent-command.ts:73 - COMMAND_MAX_DEPTH = 3
commander.ts:18 - commandOrder resolves the report route

nodes.label: Corner lifecycle
nodes.excerpt: opened -> implement -> checks -> review -> landed, closed terminal. Every transition goes through advanceCorner under the run lock; the brief authorized by a human message bounds the work.

links.label: corner-lifecycle.ts:78 - CORNER_LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT
corner-brief.ts:304 - resolveCornerBriefApproval

nodes.label: Merge gate
nodes.excerpt: mergeAllowed = live checks green AND a yes on the exact head AND no hold. One approval row per corner, bound to PR number + head SHA; a new commit cancels the yes.

links.label: corner-lifecycle.ts:1400 - cornerMergeGate
corner-merge-approval.ts:17 - recordCornerMergeApproval

nodes.label: GitHub (via GitHub App)
nodes.excerpt: Checks are read live from the PR head's rollup; webhooks only trigger re-reads. landCorner is the one merge path: brief gate, live gate, claim the head, squash-merge.

links.label: github-operations.ts:1223 - landCorner, the one merge path

nodes.label: Body: machine helper
nodes.excerpt: One helper process per machine hosts every paired agent in-process. The server pings the live socket every 30s; helpers learn of work only through the socket - no polling.

nodes.label: ACP adapters
nodes.excerpt: session/new, session/prompt, session/request_permission to the operator-installed CLI: Codex, Claude Code, Goose, Pi, Grok, Cursor, OpenCode. The harness's own loop runs the turn.

links.label: acp.ts:7 - the ACP surface every harness is driven through

nodes.label: bwrap sandbox
nodes.excerpt: A pure mount plan per session: Room = checkout read-only; corner = worktree writable. Private /tmp, credential paths masked, sibling agents' homes masked. Not a security perimeter: one shared Unix account.

links.label: bwrap-sandbox.ts:495 - sandboxMountPlan, the session mount table

nodes.label: Corner worktree
nodes.excerpt: Worktrees live at <root>/beeline/corners/<cornerId>, cut from a shared bare clone. Before every turn: fetch origin/<branch>, fast-forward, rebase, or realign on conflict. Never force-push.

links.label: room-runtime.ts:133 - materializeCornerWorktree
corner-branch-sync.ts:16 - two agents, one branch

nodes.label: Harness CLI
nodes.excerpt: The agent loop Beeline does not own: the operator's installed harness, its native session and its own sign-in, resumed across helper restarts. Beeline adds its MCP surface and the brief.

links.label: harness-tool-scope.ts:78 - CLAUDE_TOOL_SCOPE_SETTINGS: connectors off

nodes.label: Local keys + sign-ins
nodes.excerpt: Provider keys live only in ~/.config/beeline/providers.json (mode 0600) and reach only the harness process. Wizard and sign-in secrets never become a server row, card or log.
